title: Dirent.path was removed in Node 24: use dirent.parentPath (Node >= 20.12)

problem.symptom: TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The "path" argument must be of type string. Received undefined
problem.description: fs.Dirent#path was an alias of parentPath; it is undefined in Node 24, so path.join(d.path, d.name) throws. parentPath only exists since Node 20.12/21.4.

limitations.proves: Full paths of directory entries are built correctly.

author: cafe-curator
